freeze.gate: No added synchronized, global, alternate speech or unshifted flags on held cases. At least half of planned edits must be correctly located within 16 samples of the signed shift and at IoU at least 0.60. Compare both grids using fixed bounds from the 480x360 study. Each carrier must meet the criterion.
